transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Well, I came in because... ever since my grandson was killed, things just haven't been right. My daughter can sit right beside me and hold my hand, and I know I love her. I know I do. But... I just cannot feel the warmth of it inside me at all.
Do memories of your grandson’s death ever suddenly come back in a way that feels like you’re reliving it?

Yes, they do. I can just be sitting there, maybe folding a quilt square or reaching for my tea, and... all of a sudden I hear those shots again. I see him lying there outside the community center. It feels exactly like it is happening right in front of me.
Do you try to avoid reminders of your grandson’s death?

Yes, I do. I absolutely will not go near that street anymore. And I don't answer any calls about the repast at the center. I just can't do it. Even the music... if second-line music comes on the radio or TV, I have to turn it off the very instant I hear it. It just pulls me straight back there.
Since your grandson died, have you felt emotionally numb, like you cannot feel love or closeness the way you used to?

Yes, exactly. Like I said when I first came in... it's like there's a wall there. My daughter can be right there, holding my hand, and in my mind, I know I love her. I know she's my daughter. But I just can't feel that warmth or that connection inside me anymore. It's just... gone.
Do you have nightmares about your grandson’s death?

No, I don't really have nightmares. I just... I don't sleep much at all, to be honest. But when I do, I haven't noticed any bad dreams about it. It's mostly just when I'm awake that it comes back to me.
Since your grandson died, have you felt constantly on guard or easily startled?

Yes, I have. I'm very jumpy now. If the ice maker drops cubes in the kitchen, or if a car backfires down the block, my whole body just jumps. I jump so hard I have to grab the table to steady myself. And my heart... it just keeps pounding and pounding long after everyone else has settled down. I just can't seem to relax.
How long have these symptoms been going on since your grandson died?
It's been six days. All of this started... well, it's been exactly six days since he was killed outside the community center.
